nen.hxh.reaction.enhancement: The water overflows from the glass!
nen.hxh.reaction.transmutation: You taste the water... it tastes completely different!
nen.hxh.reaction.emission: The water changes color before your eyes!
nen.hxh.reaction.manipulation: The leaf moves on its own!
nen.hxh.reaction.specialization: The leaf dries up and withers before your eyes!
nen.hxh.hint.enhancement: The water level seems slightly higher...
nen.hxh.hint.transmutation: There is a strange taste in the air near the glass...
nen.hxh.hint.emission: For a moment, the water looked like a different color...
nen.hxh.hint.conjuration: You could swear a tiny speck is floating in the water...
nen.hxh.hint.specialization: The edge of the leaf looks a little drier...
nen.hxh.technique.ten.lore: Keeps aura flowing in and around the body instead of leaking away. It works like a second skin that softens blows and slows aging.
nen.hxh.technique.ken.lore: Holds a strong layer of aura over the whole body. It protects everything at once, but tires you quickly and is weaker than focusing aura on one spot.
nen.hxh.technique.ken.effect: Resistance II. Costs 3 aura per second.
nen.hxh.technique.zetsu.lore: Closes the aura nodes and stops aura from flowing out. It hides your presence and relieves fatigue, but leaves you without any Nen protection.
nen.hxh.technique.in.lore: Hides aura completely, even during an attack. Used to catch enemies off guard; only Gyo or an En can expose it.
nen.hxh.technique.in.effect: Invisibility and Strength I. Costs 2 aura per second.
nen.hxh.technique.ren.lore: Produces and expands a large amount of aura around the body, boosting strength and durability. It is the base of offensive techniques.
nen.hxh.technique.ren.effect: Strength I. Costs 3 aura per second.
nen.hxh.technique.gyo.lore: Concentrates aura in one part of the body. In the eyes, it lets you see other people's aura and things hidden with In.
nen.hxh.technique.gyo.effect: Night vision and makes nearby invisible creatures glow. Costs 1 aura per second.
nen.hxh.technique.ko.lore: Gathers all aura into a single point and cuts off the rest with Zetsu. The strike becomes absurdly strong, but the rest of the body is left exposed.
nen.hxh.technique.ko.effect: Strength III, but slows you down. Costs 5 aura per second.
nen.hxh.technique.ryu.lore: Moves aura around the body mid-fight, reinforcing the fist before a strike and the guard before a block. It takes a lot of practice.
nen.hxh.technique.ryu.effect: Strength II, Resistance II and Speed I. Costs 4 aura per second.
nen.hxh.technique.shu.lore: Wraps an object in your aura as if it were part of your body. Even a sheet of paper becomes sharp as steel.
nen.hxh.technique.shu.effect: Haste II (faster tools). Costs 1 aura per second.
nen.hxh.technique.en.lore: Expands aura into a sphere around you. Anything inside it is sensed: presence, movement and shape. The bigger the circle, the higher the cost.
nen.hxh.technique.en.effect: Reveals creatures within 16 blocks. Costs 2 aura per second.
nen.hxh.technique.hatsu.lore: Projects aura outward to create a unique ability that reflects the user's Nen type and personality.
nen.hxh.technique.hatsu.effect: Unlocks your Nen type's ability (coming soon).
nen.hxh.upgrade.ten_calm.desc: While Ten is active, recover +1 aura per second.
nen.hxh.upgrade.ten_youth.desc: While Ten is active, gain Regeneration I.
nen.hxh.upgrade.ken_endurance.desc: Ken costs 1 less aura per second.
nen.hxh.upgrade.zetsu_rest.desc: While Zetsu is active, gain Regeneration I.
nen.hxh.upgrade.zetsu_step.desc: While Zetsu is active, gain Speed I.
nen.hxh.upgrade.ren_control.desc: Ren costs 1 less aura per second.
nen.hxh.upgrade.ko_focus.desc: Ko costs 2 less aura per second.
nen.hxh.upgrade.ryu_flow.desc: Ryu costs 1 less aura per second.
nen.hxh.upgrade.ryu_master.desc: Ryu grants Strength III and Resistance III.
nen.hxh.upgrade.shu_edge.desc: While Shu is active, your weapon also grants Strength I.
nen.hxh.stat.vitality.desc: Each point grants +1 heart of max health.
nen.hxh.stat.attack_speed.desc: Each point makes your attacks recharge faster.
nen.hxh.stat.agility.desc: Each point makes you 1.5% faster when walking and running.
nen.hxh.stat.aura_flow.desc: Each point recovers +1 aura per second (while no technique is spending aura).
